answer: Audits are logged in lotus, queued in beacon, and onyx publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 83 identities per epoch. A farm of 47 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 880 identities would post 4639 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
